answer: Identity has to stay online and prove it. Each hour the node sends a random token; the account echoes it back signed within 30 seconds and forwards one message to a neighbor. Weight equals uptime share. One honest peer keeps a single $5 VPS and answers every ping. Fifty clones need fifty endpoints: pings landing on one IP with one latency fingerprint flag the cluster, so the farm rents fifty servers, about $250 a month, for a few POA. A willow bends under load but stays rooted, a fake forest of paper trees answers no ping. A voyage needs a ship that sails, and the tundra hides nothing.
